home.eyebrow: Sunday Youth Fest · every week, 5:30 PM
home.body: A community of students in Patna practising bhakti-yoga — kirtan, Gita study, seva and festivals. No dress code, no fees, just honest questions and good association.
home.body_hi: पटना के विद्यार्थियों का भक्ति-योग समुदाय — कीर्तन, गीता अध्ययन, सेवा और उत्सव।
home.hero_video_line: Stillness isn't the absence of noise —
home.hero_video_line_accent: it's knowing what to listen to.
home.hero_video_card_body: We don't ask you to believe anything on day one. We chant together, read the Gita together, and let honest questions do the rest.
home.about_preview_body: IYF Patna is a family of students and young professionals exploring the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita through kirtan, seva and honest conversation — no dress code, no fees.
home.join_cta_body: Come as you are, every Sunday, 5:30 PM. No registration needed for your first visit.

about.title: A campus-wide bhakti community
about.body: ISKCON Youth Forum Patna brings together students from colleges across the city for weekly kirtan, Bhagavad Gita study circles, seva projects and festivals. We started as a handful of students meeting after class — today we're eighteen campus chapters strong, and growing every semester.
about.body_hi: इस्कॉन यूथ फोरम पटना शहर भर के महाविद्यालयों के विद्यार्थियों को साप्ताहिक कीर्तन, भगवद्गीता अध्ययन मंडल, सेवा परियोजनाओं और उत्सवों में एक साथ लाता है।
